h1: The 6 Best DeWalt Leaf Blowers of 2026, Ranked & Reviewed
metaTitle: Best DeWalt Leaf Blowers 2026: Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: two DeWalt blowers and four third-party blowers built for DeWalt 20V batteries, compared on stated CFM, power and price bracket.
summary: The DeWalt DCBL772B is the best DeWalt leaf blower if you own 60V batteries, with 600 CFM and official support. ALDIPRO lists 700 CFM for DeWalt 20V packs at a lower bracket, and Paxwrenx adds a brushless motor. The genuine DeWalt 20V MAX blower is a light cleanup tool at only 100 CFM.
intro: Search for a DeWalt leaf blower and most of the results are not DeWalt products at all. Several brands build blowers that accept DeWalt 20V batteries and sell them with that name in the title, which is convenient if you own the packs and misleading if you expect DeWalt's warranty. Read the maker's name first.

Our group has two genuine DeWalt blowers and four battery-compatible alternatives. We ranked them on stated airflow in CFM, cordless operation, motor type and price bracket, based on listing details. Milwaukee-battery blowers were left out because they do not fit DeWalt packs. Where a listing leaves out a price bracket, we say so.

products.name: Dewalt Blower AXIAL HNDHLD 60V 600CFM DCBL772B
products.description:
The DeWalt DCBL772B is a handheld axial blower on the 60V platform, rated at 600 CFM and priced in the $100 to $200 bracket. It is a genuine DeWalt product, so warranty and parts come from the manufacturer.

It leads because it is the only real DeWalt blower with serious airflow. The ALDIPRO below lists more CFM for less money, but it comes from a third party. The genuine 20V MAX blower is far weaker. For anyone who already runs 60V batteries, this is the obvious choice.

Buy it if you own 60V packs and want official support behind a strong handheld. Skip it if you only have 20V batteries, because the 60V platform uses different packs and starting from scratch adds real cost. The listing gives airflow only, so check runtime and weight before you buy.

products.name: ALDIPRO 700 CFM Leaf Blower Compatible with DeWalt 20V Max Battery
products.verdict: The highest stated CFM here, built for DeWalt 20V packs.
products.description:
ALDIPRO is a cordless blower rated at 700 CFM, the highest stated airflow in the group, built to take DeWalt 20V Max batteries. It is a third-party tool in the $50 to $100 bracket.

It lands second because it out-blows every rival on paper while costing less than the DCBL772B. The reason it does not win is that it is not made by DeWalt: warranty, parts and support depend on ALDIPRO. Batteries are also not included, so the real cost depends on what you already own.

Buy it if you hold a stack of 20V packs and want maximum stated airflow for little money. Skip it if you value official DeWalt support. A 700 CFM claim from a lesser-known maker deserves a quick check of owner feedback before you trust it with a big cleanup.

products.name: Paxwrenx 600 CFM Brushless Leaf Blower Compatible with DeWalt 20V Max
products.verdict: A brushless 600 CFM blower for DeWalt 20V.
products.description:
The Paxwrenx is a cordless brushless blower rated at 600 CFM, compatible with DeWalt 20V Max batteries, in the $50 to $100 bracket.

Third place comes from a close contest. It gives up 100 CFM to the ALDIPRO, which is a modest gap, and offers a brushless motor in return. Brushless designs generally run more efficiently, which can stretch a battery. For a compatible blower, that is the most compelling argument in the list.

Buy it if you want brushless efficiency and own 20V packs. Skip it if raw airflow is your priority, since the ALDIPRO leads there. It is also not made by DeWalt, so warranty runs through Paxwrenx and support may be slower than the DeWalt-built tools at the top.

products.name: Neareen 600 CFM Cordless Leaf Blower for Dewalt 20V Max Battery
products.verdict: A 600 CFM cordless blower for DeWalt 20V batteries.
products.description:
Neareen lists a cordless blower at 600 CFM for DeWalt 20V Max batteries, also in the $50 to $100 bracket.

It ranks fourth because the Paxwrenx matches its airflow and adds a brushless motor, while the Neareen makes no brushless claim. Everything else about the two is similar: compatible with the same batteries, same stated airflow, same bracket. That makes the Paxwrenx the safer pick unless the Neareen is cheaper on the day.

Buy it for light yard work and occasional leaf clearing if you already have 20V packs. Skip it if a brushless motor matters to you. Like the others in this tier, it comes from a third-party brand, so check the warranty terms and confirm the battery is not included in the price.

products.name: AUTOJARE Cordless Leaf Blower for Dewalt 20V Battery Brushless Electric Blower
products.verdict: A 520 CFM brushless blower for DeWalt 20V.
products.description:
AUTOJARE is a cordless brushless blower rated at 520 CFM for DeWalt 20V batteries. The listing gives no price bracket, so check the live price.

Fifth place reflects the lowest airflow of the compatible group. It is brushless, which counts in its favor, but 520 CFM trails the Paxwrenx and Neareen at 600, and the missing price makes comparison harder. Without a clear cost advantage, there is little reason to choose it over the options above.

Buy it for a small yard if the price looks right when you open the listing. Skip it if you need stronger airflow or want a firm price to compare. As with the other third-party blowers, confirm whether batteries come in the box and look into the warranty.

products.name: DEWALT 20V MAX Blower
products.verdict: The genuine DeWalt 20V option, at 100 CFM.
products.description:
The DeWalt 20V MAX Blower is a genuine DeWalt cordless unit rated at 100 CFM, listed in the $100 to $200 bracket. It runs on the 20V packs that many owners already have for drills.

It lands last because 100 CFM trails every other blower here by hundreds of CFM. That is far too little for leaf piles. It is useful for sweeping grass clippings off a path, clearing a garage floor or dusting a deck, and it is the only real DeWalt in the 20V class.

Buy it for patios, workshops and quick cleanup, where official support matters more than airflow. Skip it for leaf piles. If you want genuine DeWalt power for yard work, the DCBL772B is the model to look at, while 20V owners wanting airflow should consider the compatible blowers above.

whatMatters.detail: CFM is cubic feet of air per minute and measures how much air the blower moves. A higher number clears more leaves in one pass. Find it in the title or spec table. The range here runs from 100 CFM on the genuine DeWalt 20V MAX to 700 CFM on the ALDIPRO.

DeWalt sells 20V and 60V batteries, and the two are not interchangeable. Choosing the wrong platform leaves you with a blower you cannot power. Check which battery the blower takes. The DCBL772B uses 60V, while the ALDIPRO and the other compatible tools take 20V.

A compatible blower works with DeWalt batteries but is made by another company. That affects warranty, parts and service. Read the maker named on the listing and the warranty terms. ALDIPRO, Paxwrenx, Neareen and AUTOJARE are compatible tools, not DeWalt products.

Brushless motors tend to run more efficiently, which can extend battery life and reduce wear. They matter if you do long sessions. Look for the word brushless in the title. Paxwrenx and AUTOJARE list it, while the Neareen listing makes no such claim.

Many cordless tools ship as bare units without a battery or charger. If you do not already own packs, the true cost climbs quickly. Check whether battery and charger are included. The ALDIPRO listing notes that its battery is not included, and the others deserve the same check.

faq.a: Four are built for DeWalt 20V Max packs: ALDIPRO, Paxwrenx, Neareen and AUTOJARE. The DCBL772B uses the 60V platform, and the genuine 20V MAX blower uses 20V, so match the pack to the tool.
Assuming a compatible tool is a DeWalt product. Four of these six are made by other brands, which means different warranty terms and no official DeWalt support. Check the maker on the listing.

faq.q: Is the DCBL772B worth it over ALDIPRO?
faq.a: If you want official support and own 60V packs, yes. The ALDIPRO lists 700 CFM for less and fits 20V batteries, but it is a third-party tool without DeWalt backing.
Check each listing. Many are sold as bare tools, including the ALDIPRO, so confirm whether a battery and charger come in the box before assuming the quoted price covers a complete setup.

Clear debris from the intake after each use and keep the nozzle free of wet leaves. Store batteries indoors at moderate temperatures, away from extreme heat or cold, and follow the manual for the blower you choose.
Milwaukee blowers use Milwaukee batteries, which do not fit DeWalt tools. We limited this ranking to genuine DeWalt blowers and tools that accept DeWalt packs, so Milwaukee models were left out.

finalTake: For owners of 60V batteries, the DeWalt DCBL772B is the best DeWalt leaf blower, with 600 CFM and genuine support. If you only own 20V packs, the Paxwrenx or ALDIPRO give far more airflow for the money, at the cost of official backing. Choose the genuine 20V MAX blower only for patios and light cleanup, and always check the maker's name first.
